title: Top Desk Lamps for Eye Comfort (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were based on the 2024 and 2025 reviews from Insider and Business Insider, which tested and compared desk lamps for eye strain, adjustability, and price.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no cost comparison is included.

verdict.line: Picture a long study session where you need bright, adjustable light. The BenQ e‑Reading LED Desk Lamp offers a tall, highly adjustable arm and a wide color‑temperature range, making it ideal for computer work and reading. Its main catch is that it requires a separate light bulb.
